collection: Power-plant valve and carbon/stainless nozzle nonlinear transient heat conduction

FEM_history.units: seconds and Celsius; CAD/setup use mm
FEM_history.not_FEM_reference_column: Column 2 is imposed internal temperature, not a solved field target.
FEM_history.no_full_saved_nodal_file: Original mesh/valve-1.msh nodal result absent from selected repository; six source sampled FEM trajectories only.

setup.thermal: Nonlinear temperature-dependent conductivity/diffusivity, implicit transient from initial steady state
setup.BC: Internal T follows published 40 to250 to40 C profile; external convection to50 C at h=1e-6 W/(mm^2 K); symmetry adiabatic
setup.materials: Carbon steel and stainless steel temperature-dependent source properties

limitations: Four original BREP volumes; independent source surface/volume/SCL topology matching pending.
Only sampled histories, no full nodal mesh/result binary; time samples are not independent cases.
Original output rounded to 0.001 C; preserve source time samples and compare at same positions.
Exact original mesh and convergence evidence require review; no new mesh or solve generated.
Imposed-temperature column must not be used to inflate numerical accuracy.
